decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey side and rear extension would, by reason of their excessive size, position and appearance in relation to neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the outlook and residential amenities of adjoining occupiers and visual amenities of the street scene. The proposal is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development) and H3.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Single storey rear and part single storey side extension to dwellinghouse
